title: 第23章 许贼谋逆理应处死第24章 这许小凡莫不是私生子
content_zh:
剑修！
这人是谁？
难道是中土大陆来的？
众人心中极为疑惑。
到目前为止，除了与许家有过的接触的人以外，帝都还没有人认识这对父子！
这时，扬无敌冲天而起，冷笑道：
“许贼，你儿子杀了太子！
你刚刚又杀了当朝重臣！
谋逆大罪！
今日你们父子必死，识趣的最好束手就擒！”
许渊却冷笑道：
“我儿子杀人，自然有自己的理由。
我杀人，自然是刚刚那老东西不识好歹！
你难道没听过一句话吗？”
杨无敌皱眉道：“什么话？”
许渊冷笑一声，“天子犯法，与庶民同罪！”
‘轰’此言一出，人群突然喧闹起来！
天子犯法，与庶民同罪！
这简直大逆不道！
天子至高无上，这天下都是天子的，天子怎会有错！

又岂会与庶民同罪！
皇帝嘴角也抽了抽，看着半空的许渊，眼底闪过一抹玩味之色。
“许贼你大胆！”
与此同时，花妖娆也冲天而起，盯着许渊冷笑连连！
许渊看了二人一眼，下意识问道：“还有一个呢？”
杨无敌衣袍舞动，冷哼一声道：
“老阁主今天有事，没来，不过...皇城之内高手无数，即便老阁主没来，你也得死！”
话罢，他看向下方。
随即，眉头皱了皱。
除了杨家高手与花家高手，其余不管是大内高手，还是羽林卫，以及那些家族之人，都没一个要动手的意思。
因为任谁都看的出，这杨家花家与这神秘剑修有仇！
既然如此，他们何必帮忙呢？
杀了这剑修，他们没有一点好处，反而白白损害了自己的利益。
最关键的是，皇帝没有下令！
杨无敌脸色有点难看，不动声色的瞥了一眼皇帝。
跟在这位身边这么多年了，可他依旧摸不准对方的心思。
当真可怕至极！
如此，只能他们两家联手了！
然而这时，却听花妖娆话锋一转道：
“将我花家至宝还回来，今日我可退去！”

“你...”
杨无敌指着身边这女人，怒不可遏道：
“蠢妇！
咱们联手击杀此子，到时至宝还是你的！”
content_en:
Sword repair!
Who is this person?
Could it be from Middle-earth?
Everyone was extremely confused.
So far, except for people who have had contact with the Xu family, no one in the imperial capital knows this father and son!
At this time, Yang Wudi rose into the sky and sneered:
"Tie Xu, your son killed the prince!
You just killed another important minister of the court!
A heinous crime of treason!
Today you, father and son, are bound to die, and those who know better are better off holding their hands! "
Xu Yuan sneered:
"My son naturally has his own reasons for killing people.
When I kill someone, it's naturally because that old guy just now didn't know what's good and what's good!
Haven't you ever heard a sentence? "
Yang Wudi frowned and said, "What are you talking about?"
Xu Yuan sneered, "The emperor breaks the law and is guilty of the same crime as the common people!"
As soon as these words were spoken, the crowd suddenly became noisy!
The emperor breaks the law and is guilty of the same crime as the common people!
This is simply outrageous!
The Emperor is supreme, this world belongs to the Emperor, how can the Emperor make mistakes!
How can we share the same sin with the common people!
The corner of the emperor's mouth also twitched, and he looked at Xu Yuan in the air, with a hint of amusement flashing in his eyes.
"Tie Xu, you are brave!"
At the same time, Hua Yaoruo also rose into the sky, staring at Xu Yuan and sneering again and again!
Xu Yuan glanced at the two of them and asked subconsciously: "Where is the other one?"
Yang Wudi's robes danced and he snorted coldly:
"The old Pavilion Master has something to do today and is not here, but...there are countless masters in the imperial city. Even if the Old Pavilion Master does not come, you will still die!"
After saying this, he looked down.
Then, he frowned.
Except for the masters from the Yang family and the Hua family, none of the other masters, including the Ouchi masters, the Yulin guards, and those from the family, had any intention of taking action.
Because anyone can see that the Yang family’s Hua family has a grudge against this mysterious sword cultivator!
In that case, why should they help?
Killing this sword cultivator would not benefit them at all, but would harm their own interests in vain.
The most important thing is that the emperor did not give the order!
Yang Wudi looked a little ugly and glanced at the emperor calmly.
After following this person for so many years, he still couldn't figure out what the other person was thinking.
It’s so terrifying!
In this way, the two of them can only join forces!
However, at this moment, Hua Yaorao changed the subject and said:
"Return the most precious treasure of my Hua family, and I can retreat today!"
"You..."
Yang Wudi pointed at the woman beside him and said angrily:
"Stupid woman!
Let's work together to kill this kid, and then the treasure will still be yours! "
